notes.mode:link: two consoles over a link cable: not reachable with one emulator (one emulator reaches only the no-cable attempt, menu:link_wait)
notes.mode:slash: Slash Mode (100 Kills Time Trial): the top-menu row after Link Mode, enabled when menu_SetEnabledRows gets 0xFF rather than 0xF7, which its callers pass when D_80106A50.unk_04 is 0x3F: func_80035438 as the top menu is built (25C38.c:24-29) and func_80035828 on leaving the Option Menu (25C38.c:288-292); slash-mode-1 pokes unk_04 before the top menu is built

notes.menu:link_wait: Link Mode with no cable: CROSS on the top menu's Link Mode entry, a black load, Waiting for Challenger, then the top menu again (link-no-cable-1)
notes.menu:slash_records: Slash Mode's first screen: 100 Kills Time Trial Records (three times and fighters) over Start / Return to Top Menu, the confirm menu (func_80077A60 -> menu_UpdateConfirmMenu) (slash-mode-1)
notes.menu:title: the Bushido Blade 2 title after the intro movie, both run inside the movie overlay (func_8003BFC4 -> sys_ExecMovieOverlay; no hit-map function is reached while the movie and the title play); with no input it gives way to the top menu by itself (title-attract-1)
notes.menu:boot_load_prompt: the top menu's first entry with a save on the card: D_800A31D9 starts at 1 (25C38.c:458) and the subflow takes states 7 / 8 / 9 (25C38.c:200-235): Checking Memory Card, Load data from Memory Card? YES / NO (menu_StepTwoChoicePromptDrawSheetsAndRearmAfterResult, sheet 0x13, cursor on YES), YES: Checking, Load completed, the top menu; with no save the check ends the flow and no prompt shows (memory-card-boot-load-1 on blank cards: state 7 at 5968, back to state 1 at 6045). Scenarios start from blank or unformatted cards, so memory-card-boot-load-1 saves first and pokes D_800A31D9 back to 1 before returning to the top menu: a stand-in for power-on with a saved card (same code from state 1; other RAM differs)
notes.menu:debug_config: a debug fight-settings menu: main-loop handlers 2 / 3 (D_8008D090 entries: ResetGraphClearFrameCounterAndSetMainLoopHandler3, which stores 3, 17AFC.c:5464-5468, and menu_PrintEditAndApplyConfigWithPerPadCursors). The only store of 2 in the C sources is the default arm of fight_UpdateInterpolatedFighterViewAndSelectNextPhaseByModeOnTimeoutOrPadPress (handler 17, entered from func_8001EEB4, handler 16; 9F9C.c:2409-2414: a mode selector other than 1, 4 or 6); handler 17 runs in many captures, but handler 2 is in no other hit map, so that arm is untaken; debug-config-menu-1 pokes D_800A3834 to 2 instead: g_fight_config printed as numbers in two columns, per-pad cursors, START applies the pending settings

notes.stage:shainto_gate: [Map 1] .. [Map 3]: names read off the Select Battle Stage scrolls (versus-2p-stage-map3-1, versus-2p-stage-map1-2)

characters.open: Select School draws two schools, Narukagami and Shainto (group-battle-hitmap-1 school_select); 2P Vs. Mode Select Character is a grid of four columns by five rows: the six default fighters (versus-2p-stage-map1-6 char_select.first), and with the unlock word D_80106A50.unk_00 set (versus-2p-hidden-roster-1) all 20 names; every one of the 14 further fighters now has its own fight vs GENGORO (versus-2p-hidden-<fighter>, HIGHWAYMAN in versus-2p-hidden-roster)

notes.char:utsusemi: char:utsusemi .. char:katze: the 14 names drawn only with the unlock word set, reached by P1's cursor on Select Character (portrait drawn, versus-2p-hidden-roster-1 char_select.* shots); each fought GENGORO on Building Rooftop by its versus-2p-hidden-<fighter> scenario (HIGHWAYMAN by versus-2p-hidden-roster)

notes.weapon:naginata: the six weapons drawn on the 2P Vs. Mode Select Weapon scroll, left to right, names as the label under the portrait shows them (versus-2p-weapon-tour-1); KANNUKI's cursor stops at Long Sword, GENGORO's reaches Yari
notes.weapon:katana: weapon ids of the six scroll weapons (record unk_0E at the fight start, D_80101EC8+0xE / +0x44C+0xE) picked in versus-2p-kimigaura-weapon-<P1>-<P2>-1 (labels on weapon_select.pick): Katana 0, Long Sword 1, Nodachi 2, Broadsword 3, Naginata 4, Yari 5 (not the scroll order); with weapon:id_6 and weapon:id_7 the list is closed: no unk_0E comparison in src/main names an id above 7
notes.weapon:id_6: weapon:id_6 / weapon:id_7: weapons no Select Weapon scroll draws (it shows the same six for every fighter), named by their weapon id (fighter_Init a3, record unk_0E) since the game shows no name for them; each is a hidden fighter's own default weapon, held in its fight screenshots: id 6 TSUBAME's (fighter_Init a2 8 a3 6; record 0 unk_0E 6 at the fight start: versus-2p-hidden-tsubame-weapon-1), id 7 KATZE's (a2 0x16 a3 7: versus-2p-hidden-katze-1). Only ids 6 and 7 spend the counter unk_34A on an attack's first hit frame (weapon_hit_start_frames[0]) and cast a weapon segment, or call code 0x32 when it is empty (17AFC.c:1713-1729; unk_0C 0x1D / 0xE spend it on [1], 17AFC.c:1730-1736); fighter_Init sets it to 10, or 2 for unk_0C 0x1D / 0xE, in the last arm of its mode test (9F9C.c:3853-3862); both records read 10 at the fight start. KATZE's spend: versus-2p-hidden-katze-gun-1

notes.event:ko: a fighter down for good (no health bar: one cut can kill)
notes.event:hit: a cut lands without a KO, shown on screen (an IPPON call is the killing cut, not this)
notes.event:guard: a blocked cut, shown on screen: an attack inside its blade's hit window meets the blade of a fighter that is not attacking, and both stay up. Code-level test (versus-2p-blade-contact-1, all three contacts at 9235, 10557, 10615): fighter_ResolveWeaponContact runs (blade on blade); the attacker in move_kind 2 with weapon_hit_phases 5, the other fighter in walk move 0x801494ac (move_kind 0x19, reached by holding RIGHT with no button, movegraph) with weapon_hit_phases 0 and only RIGHT held on its pad; after it the walker gets the common-file move kind 0x2C and the attacker its own kind 0xE, kinds no input reaches (0x2C offers a CROSS counter-cut, taken after the first contact); the landed leg cut instead gives the target the common kind 3 and the attacker carries on (versus-2p-wound-moves-1, 9482)
notes.event:save: data saved to a memory card
notes.event:load: data loaded from a memory card
notes.event:key_config_change: a button moved to a Key Configuration row (taken off its old row) and one pad's rows reset with Default, shown on screen (key-config-edit-1)
notes.event:best_time: a Slash Mode 100 Kills Time Trial finished and its time entered in the Records (fight_InsertBestTime), shown on the Records screen (slash-mode-clear-1: the opponent number poked to 100, so one kill finishes the trial)
notes.event:format: an unformatted memory card formatted from the game, after the Memory Card is unformatted / Format? prompt (memory-card-format-1)
notes.event:overwrite: a save written over earlier save data on the card, after the Overwrite data? / Previous data will be erased prompt (memory-card-overwrite-1)
notes.event:attract_loop: the top menu left with no input: func_80035828 counts its calls (one per main-loop pass) in D_800A37B8 (any held button resets it to 1) and at 0xCA9 stores mode 0xF (25C38.c:243-249), whose handler func_8003BFC4 calls sys_ExecMovieOverlay again with the boot's arguments (the movie and the title), then the top menu (title-attract-1)
notes.event:top_menu_back: TRIANGLE on the top menu: func_80035828's cancel result starts cdrom_StartMixFade and a 60-pass countdown, then cdrom_PauseAndWait and mode 0xF (25C38.c:258-276), so func_8003BFC4 runs the movie overlay (movie, then title) and the top menu is rebuilt (top-menu-back-1)
notes.event:movie_skip: inside the movie overlay, CROSS during the movie or on the title ends the overlay call within 2 frames (sys_Init from sys_Exec+0x9C after it returns; the title not shown when skipped from the movie) and the top menu is rebuilt; START during the movie changes nothing (top-menu-back-1)
notes.event:rematch: Rematch on the post-KO menu (func_8001EA84, 9F9C.c:2129; row 0): the fight restarts on the same stage with no load (mode 0 at pc 0x8001EE44 and 1 the next frame; a stage load stores mode 0 at pc 0x80035D68 / 0x800346D4 and 1 ~775 frames later), P1's side reading WINS 01; fight_FindNearestStartPair (start pair nearest record D_800A3748's position, into D_800A38DF) and, only when record 1 is CPU, fighter_HalveCpuTally (9F9C.c:2197-2205; versus-2p-rematch-1 is 2P: no HalveCpuTally)
notes.event:rematch_sub_menu: Return to Sub Menu on the post-KO menu (row 1): cdrom_PauseAndWait, func_8001DA2C (snd_ResetVoicesAndQueue, snd_StopVoicesAndReverb, 9F9C.c:1699-1708), mode 8, then Select Character; on the next Select Battle Stage DOWN, DOWN, RIGHT reaches Bamboo Thicket as from Building Rooftop on the first visit, and the next fight reads WINS 00 / 00 WINS (9F9C.c:2208-2213; versus-2p-rematch-1)
notes.event:rematch_top_menu: Return to Top Menu on the post-KO menu (row 2): the same func_8001DA2C and mode 8 store as row 1 without D_800A31DA, then the top menu (9F9C.c:2215-2219; versus-2p-rematch-1)
notes.event:pov_view: a fight seen first-person: RIGHT on the top menu lights POV in its Side View / POV box; at the mode start 0x80102786 (D_80102778.unk_E) and D_800A38BA (func_800343F0, 24BF0.c:17-23) are set to 1, so fight setup calls camera_InitTrackedFighterFocus and each fight update camera_UpdateTrackedFighterView (9F9C.c:1940-1942, 2085-2087); the screen shows a green line figure over the scene (story-pov-rematch-1)
notes.event:draw: a Group Battle team match tied: with Time Limit 60 sec and no fight input every bout times out with no point (fight_RecordMatchResult result 2, the roster shows a triangle - triangle per row), so func_8003C42C finds equal wins and equal point sums and stores D_800A382D 2 (2B344.c:776-791); the result screen shows no victory text, then the tie's menu (func_8003C958 / func_8003C9A4, modes 0x18 / 0x19: Rematch / Return to Sub Menu / Return to Top Menu), whose Rematch row restarts the match at bout 1 (2B344.c:951-957; group-battle-draw-1)
notes.event:group_p2_victory: a Group Battle team match won by P2's school: every bout ends with P2 ahead (fight_RecordMatchResult result 1; a bout that times out goes to the side with the IPPON point, bout 1 of group-battle-shainto-wins-1), so fight_TallyMatchResultsAndInitPresentation stores D_800A382D 1 (2B344.c:776-777); after the 0 - 3 roster fight_UpdateMatchTallyPresentation stores D_800A38A4 5 (the winner's school flag: Shainto) and mode 0x12 (2B344.c:822-823), and func_8003C040 loads the winning school's fighter into record 0 (the D_800A38A4 5 / P1 Narukagami arm, 2B344.c:710-715) for Shainto Victorious! and its dance, then the post-match menu (modes 0x18 / 0x19), whose Return to Sub Menu row stores D_800A31DA 1 and mode 8: the Group Battle Mode settings again (2B344.c:966-970; group-battle-shainto-wins-1)
notes.event:vs_cpu_clear: a Vs. CPU run finished with an opponent order shorter than 0x14: after P1's kill fight_AdvanceOpponentOrder (from the post-KO handler's D_800A38DC 1 / D_800A3748 0 arm, 9F9C.c:2277-2282) finds D_800A3783 == D_800A391F and stores mode 0x20 (17AFC.c:5512); func_8003CCCC / func_8003CD10 (modes 0x20 / 0x21) draw <D_800A391F> Kills Completed! (func_800600C8), then mode 8 and the top menu (2B344.c:978-1007). On blank cards the order holds 5 (fight_BuildOpponentOrder); versus-cpu-clear-1 pokes the counter to 5 at the fight start so the first kill ends the run; versus-cpu-clear-retail-1 wins all five fights with no poke (P1 CROSS, then TRIANGLE / CROSS, every 20 frames) and draws the same screen
notes.event:vs_cpu_ending: a Vs. CPU run finished with an order of 0x14 opponents: fight_AdvanceOpponentOrder takes its 0x14 arm, D_800A38A4 2 (P1's school flag 0; 3 otherwise) and mode 0x12 (17AFC.c:5504-5510), so func_8003C040 / func_8003C2C0 (modes 0x12 / 0x13) play 20 Kills Completed! Excellent Accomplishment and a Bushido Dance titled Temari, danced by the P1 fighter (KANNUKI here; the title and motion index are keyed on D_800A38A4, 2B344.c:705, 718, and the motion call also takes fighter 0's unk_12, so whether the dance differs per fighter is not shown), then mode 8 (2B344.c:753) and the top menu (versus-cpu-ending-1: on blank cards the order holds 5, so the length and the counter are both poked to 0x14 at the fight start; in one uncommitted scratch run (KANNUKI, versus-2p-hidden-roster's unlock word) fight_BuildOpponentOrder stored D_800A391F 20 by itself; the count depends on the unlock bits and P1's fighter, 17AFC.c:5379-5495)
notes.event:concede: a fighter concedes: SELECT in a fight installs the common move kind 0x2D (89 frames: the fighter lays the sword down and kneels) and then kind 5 (movegraph: SELECT pressed with no direction or attack button); fight_UpdateFighterInteractionsAndPointCaches then stores D_800A3748 (the other record) and mode 0x1C (17AFC.c:2321-2327), fight_InitNearestStartPairPlayback / fight_UpdateNearestStartPairPlaybackAndReinitMotionStreams (modes 0x1C / 0x1D, 2B344.c:1011-1138) play a cutscene: the opponent behind the kneeling fighter with the sword raised, then the kneeling fighter lying on the floor; in Vs. modes (D_800A38DC 4 or 6) the opponent's wins byte (&D_800A37D2)[D_800A3748] goes up by one and mode 0x18 brings the post-KO menu, in Story (D_800A38DC 0, D_800A3836 not 0xFF) func_8003B534(4) instead (event:story_substitute_concede) (versus-2p-concede-1: P1 then P2 concede; the rematch HUD reads 01 WINS for P2, and the wins bytes D_800A37D2 / D_800A37D3 read 01 01 after the second)
notes.event:story_concede: a fighter concedes in Story Mode with no fighter substituted (D_800A3836 0xFF as fight_InitCommandStream leaves it; fight_SaveFighter0SelectionAndStateSubstituteStreamSelectionClearState saves P1's selection there when the stream substitutes another fighter, 2B344.c:240): the same kneel, D_800A3748 and mode 0x1C store and cutscene as event:concede; D_800A38DC 0, so no wins byte changes, and with D_800A3836 0xFF mode 0x18 brings the post-KO menu (2B344.c:1127-1135), the Rematch menu (story-concede-1: P1 KANNUKI concedes the first fight, modes 0x1C 9209, 0x1D 9267, 0x18 9868, 0x19 9870; the substituted-fighter arm is event:story_substitute_concede)
notes.event:story_substitute_concede: a fighter concedes in a Story Mode fight where the command stream's op 2 substitutes P1's fighter (fight_RunCommandStream: D_800A3894 <- the op's 29 operand bytes, fight_SaveFighter0SelectionAndStateSubstituteStreamSelectionClearState saves P1's selection in D_800A3836 and puts the op's first byte in its place, 2B344.c:238-250, 401-406): the same kneel, D_800A3748 and mode 0x1C store and cutscene as event:concede; D_800A38DC 0 and D_800A3836 not 0xFF, so fight_RestoreFighter0SelectionAndStateKeepingDisplacedPairAndResetFighter0Fields gives P1 its own fighter back (D_800A3836 0xFF) and func_8003B534(4) stores D_800A37B0 4, mode 6 and D_800A3878 = D_800A3894 + 17, the op's branch-4 entry (2B344.c:312-316, 1127-1132): its scene plays and the stream goes on with P1's own fighter (story-substitute-concede-1: KANNUKI's op 2 block poked to the front of his stream, a modified game; P1 as fighter 7 concedes, modes 0x1C 9402, 0x1D 9460, D_800A3836 0xFF 10061, D_800A37B0 4 and mode 6 10212, a KANNUKI scene, KANNUKI then fights the ninja from 10602)
notes.event:story_ending: Story Mode finished: the command stream reaches op 0 with D_800A380C 0, so fight_RunCommandStream stores D_800A38A4 (P1's school flag) and mode 0x12 (2B344.c:384-387): Victorious! / Excellent Accomplishment / Bushido Dance and the dance (modes 0x12 / 0x13); with D_800A38A4 below 2 mode 0xA follows (2B344.c:750-751): fight_InitScrollingSpriteDisplayAndAudio and fight_UpdateScrollingSpriteDisplayAndMergeBitFlags (modes 0xA / 0xB) play the staff roll to 完; at its end (or a CROSS) the bits of D_800A37A4 and, for the six default fighters, P1's bit in D_80106A50.unk_04 are merged into the save record and mode 0x1A brings the save prompt when anything changed, else mode 8 (2B344.c:628-654). story-ending-poke-1: KANNUKI's stream with its own end moved to the front (a modified game; the fight's CPU byte 0x00 where the stream has 0xC0), bit 0 of unk_04 set, saved; unk_04 0x3F (all six bits) is what enables Slash Mode (mode:slash)
